business_problem: Spellbook needed to review, redline, and route very large volumes of contracts fast enough for lawyers and legal teams, while keeping issue spotting consistent and aligning recommendations with each team's preferred review style.
solution_summary: Spellbook runs a mostly-Claude contract workflow on the Claude Platform. Contracts can be pulled in from email, Slack, or Salesforce before a lawyer opens them, then Claude-powered agents flag risks, draft redlines inside Microsoft Word, compare terms to market, and feed newer autonomous contract-management flows that move agreements through triage, review, negotiation, storage, and ongoing monitoring. Roughly 15 Claude agent configurations handle the review surface alone, matching model depth to task complexity: Opus 5 and Opus 4.6 on the hardest subtasks, Sonnet 4.6 where speed and tone matter, and Fable 5 as the oracle model in evaluation pipelines. Spellbook judges production quality by user acceptance of suggestions and repeated consistency checks, while its engineering team uses Claude Code with Fable planning and review to keep shipping new legal workflows.
